verdict.rationale: Trello offers automation and a REST API, so plan limits and overage behavior are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack says what happens when automation runs or API calls exceed plan limits, whether that means extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop. The automation and API docs cited cover features and authentication only, and the free-plan mention and add-on complaint say nothing about overage handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
